$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHL (AIP France, chart dated 2023-07-13): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Langogne - Lespéron

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Asphalt strip 100 x 15 m starting from THR 22, in poor condition.

RWY 04 and 22 use is limited to: Ultralight ACFT; Helicopter; Gliders; Plane whose pilots can prove:; to be home-based ACFT pilots; or to be a holder of the mountain license; or to have recognized beforehand the platform with an instructor and have used the aerodrome as captain within 12 last months.
Air navigation hazard Trees located at 10 m from THR 22, 89 ft ASFC.
RWY 04 is preferred RWY for landing.
RWY 22 is preferred RWY for take-off.
Touch and go and low height training patterns are prohibited.
LDG RWY 22: presence of trees 89 ft ASFC imposes a plan of approach > 8.5 %.
Activated HJ by NOTAM on SAT, SUN and public HOL, when LF-R 55C is not in use.
Activity known by MARSEILLE ACC (FL > 145) and by CLERMONT INFO.
